newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Motorola strong buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Motorola strong buy repeated.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co repeated a strong buy rating on Motorola Inc after a successful launch of a Delta II rocket which carried the first of five IRIDIUM satellites into orbit. Motorola holds a 25 percent stake in IRIDIUM, a planned global communications network.

-- The successful launch of the first of five satellites out of a planned total 66-satellite network clears the way for the IRIDIUM network to be operational in 1998, Gruntal analyst Mona Eraiba said in a report.

-- The first launch is a critical step for Motorola's effort to proceed in a public offering of IRIDIUM LLC shares. A successful public offering of IRIDIUM will be a major step in lifting the financial burden off of Motorola, she said.
-- Shares of Motorola were trading off 3/4 to 62-3/8.
